authoring: Rhai code with synchronized typed companion

behaviors.description: Arrange the whole typed graph, then select a region and arrange only that region. Undo and Redo.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Unselected/manual positions, node identities and viewport survive; playing still follows the same six-point route.

behaviors.description: Add and move a wire reroute, save/reopen the graph, maximize and restore its panels.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Waypoints persist in order, node fields remain reachable and saved panel dimensions return.

behaviors.description: Play. Use WASD or arrow keys to collect the six checkpoints in order.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Each checkpoint adds one point; the sixth displays completion.

behaviors.description: Press R after completion and collect the first checkpoint again.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Score and route restart; the first checkpoint can be collected again.

behaviors.description: Open the gameplay script and switch between Code and Visual three times.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: All statements remain typed nodes; source comments, variables and custom functions remain present.

behaviors.description: Select a numeric Literal node used by movement, change its Rhai spelling, save, and inspect Code.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Only the intended expression changes; the script passes syntax/VM validation and movement uses the new speed.

behaviors.description: Add an invalid delimiter in Code, attempt Visual, then cancel and repair it.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The invalid draft stays in Code with its diagnostic; repair enables conversion without losing the draft.

behaviors.description: Save the project, reopen, play, and export Web or Windows on the corresponding available host.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The same linked source/graph and six-checkpoint route survive reopening; exported runtime uses the selected Script2D asset.
